fusions.name: Unwarded Blow
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy with cold iron, dealing 30 damage that ignores its resistances and making it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbending Shove
fusions.desc: Thrusts forward with your whole cold weight, dealing 11 damage to every enemy in a cone 3 tiles ahead and leaving each [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Spurn the Spell
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Cold to the Core
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%, and you have 10% arcane resistance.
